question.worked_solution:
First, remember that a fraction represents a division.  So, a fraction of fractions is a division of two fractions:

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{(\frac{3}{7})}{(\frac{1}{4})}=\frac{3}{7}÷\frac{1}{4}\end{aligned}
$$

Now, recall that dividing by $\frac{1}{4}$ is the same as multiplying by its reciprocal $\frac{4}{1}.$ We can use this fact to simplify the fraction above:

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{3}{7}÷\frac{1}{4} & = \\ \frac{3}{7}\times \frac{4}{1} & = \\ \frac{3\times 4}{7\times 1} & = \\ \frac{12}{7}\end{aligned}
$$

  

Therefore,

$$
\frac{(\frac{3}{7})}{(\frac{1}{4})}=\frac{12}{7}.
$$
